title: The dashboard unit tests are source-text greps whose case names claim runtime behaviour (the pause banner "returns null", the circuit-breaker reset gate requires RESET), so no dashboard behaviour is executed and the registered dashboard state defects pass them

evidence.note: header: source-text grep guards, not render tests (no @testing-library/react or jsdom)
"Test 1: returns null when pauseState is null or paused is false" asserts the source contains that expression
the RESET confirm gate is checked by text only
same pattern for the anti-rug badge and monitor tile

sibling_sites_checked: All three dashboard unit files are grep-only by design; dashboard behaviour is not covered by any test in the TESTU slice (DASH slice findings AUD-DASH-001..-003 are the runtime defects).
severity_rationale: S3: the files say openly that they are greps, but the case names read as behaviour; the hidden registered defects (AUD-DASH-001 anti-rug state wiped by the 5 s push, AUD-DASH-002 circuit-breaker trip not re-loaded) are S2.
recommendation: Phase 28: rename the cases to what they check, and add a render test harness (jsdom + testing-library) for the pause banner, the anti-rug state badge and the circuit-breaker reset flow.
affected_cases: Test 1: returns null when pauseState is null or paused is false
Test 4: Resume POST does NOT setState/setPauseState locally (WS event drives unmount)
Test 21/23: RESET-text gate via ConfirmDialog requireConfirmText machinery
Test 15: renders 6 distinct badge state variants
escaped_regression: Keep the text if (!pauseState || !pauseState.paused) return null in PauseBanner.tsx but render the banner before it (or wipe antiRugState on every positions_update, AUD-DASH-001): the greps stay green.
